result.card: Updates the minisketch subtree to incorporate upstream PR #105, declaring ID_TRANS as inline constexpr in C++17 or newer. This avoids unused constant variable warnings in translation units that include the header without using ID_TRANS. The update unblocks PR #36275, which enables the -Wunused-const-variable compiler warning flag across the project.
